issues_detected.description: ethical_reviews is populated, but its single entry (reviewing_organization 'CHoRUS consortium') describes 'community-facing ethics focus groups to determine what data is appropriate for public sharing' and analysis of 'the existing legal and regulatory landscape'. issues_detected.description: involves_human_subjects: true with special_populations 'Critically ill patients admitted to ICU, PICU, and NICU' and direct_collection.is_direct: false, yet informed_consent and at_risk_populations are absent. issues_detected.description: is_deidentified.method names tokenization (OHNLP), imaging de-identification and 'transformations that limit re-identification', and participant_privacy.privacy_techniques repeats this, but deidentification_details states imaging de-identification was 'in process for a larger cohort' and no reidentification_risk, standard (Safe Harbor / expert determination) or identifier-removal list is given.
